description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) GILDED CHAMPION (Auric Champions, 1 CP) — WP-C5. Fixture cus11e_c5_active (P1 Custodes active, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_cus11e_c5_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the Custodes detachment flipped (stratagems reloaded), auto wound allocation, Trajann's Moment Shackle marked spent (its prompt is not under test), the Custodes unreadied (Martial Ka'tah not under test), straight to the phase under test (Movement phase) — Trajann Valoris has used Moment Shackle (once per battle). No window ('Any phase, when a CHARACTER model has used a once-per-battle ability'): the player real-clicks the S button, GILDED CHAMPION's Use button and Trajann in the unit picker (1 CP): Moment Shackle can be used again; entering the next Fight phase offers it again (the Moment Shackle card in the start-of-phase window, WP-C7).
